units.source_text: 五屉柜的铁环咯当当地响。

en.t: The iron rings on the five-drawer chest clattered noisily.

units.source_text: 道子急忙从柜里取出外出用的腰带。

en.t: Michiko hurriedly took an outing sash from the chest.

units.source_text: 我凝视着她，身上的疲劳顿时消失了。

en.t: I gazed at her, and the fatigue in my body vanished at once.
